Nuggets 114Pacers 102

Denver led by 27, then held on

Final · Sat, Nov 7 · Indiana

Jokić had 19 points, 13 rebounds and 8 assists. Denver led by as many as 27.

▶ Jump to the play

1 · What happened

The game, in 5 parts.

THE STORY · SCROLL
1 of 5 · How it went

Won the second quarter 37–22

Up 8 after one quarter, the Nuggets won the second quarter 37–22 to lead 64–41.

2 of 5 · Who carried it

Jokić: 19 points, 13 rebounds, 8 assists

10 in the first quarter. Two assists shy of a triple-double.

3 of 5 · The Pacers’ side

From the Pacers’ side.

Lost the second quarter 22–37, then won the rest of the game 61–50.

4 of 5 · Where it was won

Won it inside and on the glass

Points in the paint 54–44; rebounds 51–45. Denver turned it over just 3 times.

5 of 5 · What it meant

Nuggets 114, Pacers 102.

The Nuggets move to 6–4, 9th in the West. The Pacers fall to 4–8, 11th in the East.
